cases.purpose: On the SELinux image as uid 2000, ns lsm-detect reports selinux available (and -V binds it), ns lsm-onexec writes the context to attr/exec, and the exec'd child, like runcon(1), a native attr/exec write and ns spawn lsm, runs in the policy-allowed unconfined_t domain while the caller and a plain child stay in their own domain; an unknown type fails with status 1 and EINVAL.
cases.oracle: SELinux kernel interfaces read independently of the candidate: /sys/kernel/security/lsm, /sys/fs/selinux/enforce and policyvers, /proc/self/attr/current and attr/exec, getenforce, sesearch over the loaded policy, runcon(1) and a native bash write to /proc/self/attr/exec as the same-request controls, and the Debian coreutils cat for the denied read (EACCES is the oracle: the guest has no auditd and the denial AVC is not reliably in dmesg).
cases.comparison: Exact expectation for status and output derived independently of the candidate; raw stdout, stderr and fixture files are retained as diagnostics.
cases.script:
guard_guest() {
  local token vendor virt inside outside length extra
  local -a uid_rows
  [[ -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || return 125
  IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || return 125
  IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || return 125
  [[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || return 125
  (( UID == EUID )) || return 125
  if (( EUID == 0 )); then
    mapfile -t uid_rows </proc/self/uid_map || return 125
    (( ${#uid_rows[@]} == 1 )) || return 125
    read -r inside outside length extra <<<"${uid_rows[0]}" || return 125
    [[ $inside == 0 && $outside == 2000 && $length == 1 && -z $extra ]] || return 125
  else
    (( EUID == 2000 )) || return 125
  fi
  virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || return 125
  [[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || return 125
}
guard_guest || { printf 'refusing non-fixture guest\n' >&2; exit 125; }
[[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/sbin
cur() { tr -d '\0' < /proc/self/attr/current; }
caller=$(cur); u=${caller%%:*}; rest=${caller#*:}; r=${rest%%:*}; rest=${rest#*:}; t=${rest%%:*}; lvl=${rest#*:}
target=$u:$r:unconfined_t:$lvl
lsm=$(< /sys/kernel/security/lsm)
echo "major-lsm=$([[ ,$lsm, == *,selinux,* && ,$lsm, != *,apparmor,* ]] && echo selinux || echo other) mode=$(getenforce) selinuxfs=$(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE /sys/fs/selinux) policyvers=$(< /sys/fs/selinux/policyvers)"
echo "detect=$(ns lsm-detect)"; kind=unset; ns lsm-detect -V kind; echo "detect-V=$kind"
echo "caller=$caller"
echo "policy-allows=$(sesearch -A -s "$t" -t unconfined_t -c process -p transition 2>/dev/null | grep -cx "allow $t unconfined_t:process transition;") entrypoint=$(sesearch -A -s unconfined_t -t bin_t -c file -p entrypoint 2>/dev/null | grep -c entrypoint)"
echo "pending=$( ns lsm-onexec "$target" && { IFS= read -r -d '' x </proc/self/attr/exec; printf '%s' "$x"; } )"
echo "onexec-child=$( { ns lsm-onexec "$target" && exec /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current; } | tr -d '\0')"
echo "native-child=$( { printf '%s' "$target" >/proc/self/attr/exec && exec /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current; } | tr -d '\0')"
echo "runcon-child=$(runcon "$target" /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current | tr -d '\0')"
echo "spawn-child=$(ns spawn lsm "$target" none /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current | tr -d '\0')"
echo "plain-child=$(/usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current | tr -d '\0')"
echo "caller-after=$(cur)"
( ns lsm-onexec "$u:$r:bashos_no_such_t:$lvl" ) 2>bad.err; rc=$?
echo "invalid rc=$rc einval=$([[ $(< bad.err) == *'lsm-onexec: write /proc/self/attr/exec: Invalid argument'* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
cases.stdout:
major-lsm=selinux mode=Permissive selinuxfs=selinuxfs policyvers=33
detect=selinux: available
detect-V=selinux
caller=system_u:system_r:initrc_t:s0
policy-allows=1 entrypoint=1
pending=system_u:system_r:unconfined_t:s0
onexec-child=system_u:system_r:unconfined_t:s0
native-child=system_u:system_r:unconfined_t:s0
runcon-child=system_u:system_r:unconfined_t:s0
spawn-child=system_u:system_r:unconfined_t:s0
plain-child=system_u:system_r:initrc_t:s0
caller-after=system_u:system_r:initrc_t:s0
invalid rc=1 einval=yes

cases.purpose: With real root on the SELinux image, a dedicated CIL domain is loaded at runtime; ns lsm-onexec and ns spawn lsm put the exec'd child in it (as runcon does); in enforcing mode, set only around the checks, the confined child is denied a file the caller reads (EACCES, no leak) while in permissive mode it reads it; permissive mode is restored before semodule -r, and cleanup is proven (module unlisted, enforce 0, type gone).

cat > bashos_lsm_w5.cil <<CIL
(type bashos_lsm_w5_t)
(roletype $r bashos_lsm_w5_t)
(typeattributeset domain (bashos_lsm_w5_t))
(type bashos_lsm_w5_secret_t)
(typeattributeset file_type (bashos_lsm_w5_secret_t))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_secret_t tmpfs_t (filesystem (associate)))
(allow $t bashos_lsm_w5_t (process (transition)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t bin_t (file (entrypoint execute read open map getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t file_type (dir (search getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t file_type (lnk_file (read getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t lib_t (file (read open getattr map execute)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t ld_so_t (file (read open getattr map execute)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t ld_so_cache_t (file (read open getattr map)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t proc_t (dir (search getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t proc_t (lnk_file (read getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t self (dir (search getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t self (file (read open getattr)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t self (process (fork sigchld)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t domain (fd (use)))
(allow bashos_lsm_w5_t domain (fifo_file (read write getattr ioctl append)))

semodule -i bashos_lsm_w5.cil >semodule.out 2>&1; echo "semodule-i rc=$? module-listed=$(semodule -l | grep -cx bashos_lsm_w5)"
target="$u:$r:bashos_lsm_w5_t:$lvl"
echo secret > secret.txt; chmod 644 secret.txt
chcon -t bashos_lsm_w5_secret_t secret.txt; echo "chcon rc=$? secret-label=$(stat -c %C secret.txt)"
probe() {
  local out rc
  echo "[$1] caller-read=$(/usr/bin/cat secret.txt 2>&1)"
  echo "[$1] onexec-current=$( { ns lsm-onexec "$target" && exec /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current; } 2>&1 | tr -d '\0')"
  out=$( { ns lsm-onexec "$target" && exec /usr/bin/cat secret.txt; } 2>&1 ); rc=$?
  echo "[$1] onexec-confined-read rc=$rc denied=$([[ $out == *'Permission denied'* ]] && echo yes || echo no) leaked=$([[ $'\n'$out$'\n' == *$'\nsecret\n'* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
  echo "[$1] spawn-current=$(ns spawn lsm "$target" none /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current 2>&1 | tr -d '\0')"
  out=$(ns spawn lsm "$target" none /usr/bin/cat secret.txt 2>&1); rc=$?
  echo "[$1] spawn-confined-read rc=$rc denied=$([[ $out == *'Permission denied'* ]] && echo yes || echo no) leaked=$([[ $'\n'$out$'\n' == *$'\nsecret\n'* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
  echo "[$1] runcon-current=$(runcon "$target" /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current 2>&1 | tr -d '\0')"
  echo "[$1] stock-current=$( { ns lsm-onexec "$u:$r:unconfined_t:$lvl" && exec /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current; } 2>&1 | tr -d '\0')"
  echo "[$1] plain-child=$(/usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current | tr -d '\0') caller-after=$(cur)"
}
probe permissive
setenforce 1; echo "setenforce-1 rc=$? enforce=$(< /sys/fs/selinux/enforce)"
probe enforcing
setenforce 0; echo "setenforce-0 rc=$? enforce=$(< /sys/fs/selinux/enforce)"
semodule -r bashos_lsm_w5 >semodule-r.out 2>&1; echo "semodule-r rc=$?"
echo "cleanup: module-listed=$(semodule -l | grep -cx bashos_lsm_w5) enforce=$(< /sys/fs/selinux/enforce) mode=$(getenforce) type-present=$(seinfo -t bashos_lsm_w5_t 2>/dev/null | grep -c bashos_lsm_w5_t)"
